AD-400 Long-Distance Tunnel Inspection ROV

Built around the demands of the long run.

A specialist platform for long-distance inspection of flooded water tunnels, combining a tethered vehicle with project-specific sensing and tether management.

AD-400 at a glance

The AD-400 is a long-distance ROV for inspecting flooded water-conveyance and headrace tunnels. Manufacturer figures: 5 km maximum operating distance (official site; brochure 5.5 km), 1,000 m depth rating, 300 kg vehicle, 4K forward and 1080p rear cameras, with external tethered power.

FAQ

AD-400 questions.

How far can the AD-400 travel in a tunnel?

The official product page states a maximum operating distance of 5 km; the brochure and a manufacturer project reference describe 5.5 km. The achievable distance depends on route geometry, flow and the supplied tether package.

Which tunnels is the AD-400 designed for?

Flooded headrace and water-conveyance tunnels, typically at hydropower and water-transfer schemes, where a long route makes diver or short-tether inspection impractical.

Can the AD-400 inspect without draining the tunnel?

The manufacturer reference describes inspection inside a flooded tunnel. Whether operation can continue during the mission depends on the owner’s flow, isolation and permit arrangements.

How do I get a price for the AD-400?

Price depends on the configuration: sensors, tether length, tools and support equipment. Send a short project brief or email us, and we will reply with the questions needed for an itemised quotation.
